k.description: optional, int, default=0. Specifies the sub-diagonal below which the elements of the array are set to zero. ``k=0`` refers to main diagonal, ``k<0`` refers to sub-diagonal below the main diagonal and ``k>0`` refers to sub-diagonal above the main diagonal.

output.description: An array with same shape as input containing the upper triangle of the given array with elements below the sub-diagonal specified by ``k`` are set to zero.

constraints: jax.numpy.tril(x) returns a lower triangle of an array
jax.numpy.tri(x) returns an array with ones on and below the diagonal
